verdict: The complete held-out round replays successfully and the public calls are read-only, but status and render do not expose the completed assessment reference/lens coverage or operation health. The output therefore hides the recorded OpenAlex capability failure and all five provisional gap states. Render also omits candidate identifiers, why-found/reason details and provenance JSON despite its source comment claiming provenance is displayed.
scope: Read-only inspection of the live complete round .work/research/svd-holdout-r2 and the public Discovery status, render and context functions in the prepared WIP source. Compared output behavior with frozen R2 assessment/operation-health requirements. No source, schema, test, Git, network, connector, Vault or human-gate mutation.

failure.message: The host returned: is not safe to open (non-retryable error). No OpenAlex payload was visible.

observed_markdown: All scientific coverage and relevance remain provisional.
How do staged training and data curation affect video diffusion model quality and downstream transfer?
- Stable Video Diffusion: Scaling Latent Video Diffusion Models to Large Datasets
missing_rendered_content: assessment reference and five lens states/reasons/evidence
operation health and the HOST_SAFE_OPEN_UNAVAILABLE failure
rank contributions/suppression explanations and provenance JSON

public_call_observations.interpretation: The data exists in the public context path, but status and render do not project it.

checks.evidence: discovery.py:111-130 returns last_complete_round, candidate/rank refs and only the literal scientific_assessment label. It does not dereference the complete event assessment or expose its reference, generator, five lens states, reasons or citations. context():260-266 proves this data is available.
checks.contract_impact: R2:275-293 requires caller-supplied provisional assessment coverage to remain inspectable; a status consumer cannot distinguish the five recorded gaps from an unassessed round.
checks.required_fix: Add a non-creating complete/pending assessment projection to status and render, retaining exact artifact references and lens state/reason/evidence summaries without implying formal admission.

checks.evidence: The live stop decision records failed_requests=1 and the OpenAlex observation records outcome capability_unavailable with HOST_SAFE_OPEN_UNAVAILABLE. context():266 returns this operation_health, but status() and render() omit it entirely.
checks.contract_impact: R2:289-293 explicitly requires failed required lens requests to stay visible and both operation health and provisional coverage to be reported.
checks.required_fix: Project per-request outcome/failure summaries into status and render for complete and pending states; preserve exact failure code/message and keep failure separate from lens coverage.

checks.evidence: render():367-378 orders candidate titles from rank but emits only the escaped title and an identity-conflict suffix. It does not include the candidate_key, IDs, rank, why_found, matched terms, relevance signals, or contribution/suppression reasons. The comment at :373-374 claims provenance is displayed as JSON, but no provenance JSON is appended to the output.
checks.contract_impact: R2/R6 require deterministic candidate provenance, suppression reasons and provisional interpretation to remain auditable; the current Markdown hides those retained fields.
checks.required_fix: Render deterministic rank number, candidate key/identifiers, relevance/signals, why_found and bounded provenance/reason JSON (escaped as literal text), including conflict and suppression reasons.

checks.evidence: The live render contains only state, generic provisional sentence, question and one title; it does not render the five lens states/reasons or the failed operation even though both are retained and context exposes them.
checks.contract_impact: A Markdown-only consumer receives an incomplete report of a complete round and can mistake a successful candidate title for coverage.
checks.required_fix: Add clearly labeled provisional coverage and operation-health sections to the Markdown projection, with escaped source text and exact artifact references.

checks.evidence: render():375-378 HTML-escapes and Markdown-escapes candidate titles before emitting them. The live title is rendered as a literal list item; no provider HTML/Markdown is interpreted.
checks.remaining: Future output changes must preserve literal escaping for assessment statements, reasons and provider-derived provenance fields.

actual_findings: DOUT-STATUS-ASSESSMENT-001: status omits the completed assessment ref and lens coverage details.
DOUT-OPERATION-HEALTH-002: status and render omit the retained OpenAlex capability failure and failed-request summary.
DOUT-RENDER-CANDIDATE-PROVENANCE-003: render emits only a title/conflict marker; candidate identifiers, rank, why_found, reasons and provenance are absent despite the source comment.
DOUT-RENDER-HEALTH-COVERAGE-004: Markdown output cannot show the five provisional gap states or operation health.
limitations_and_remaining_gates: This review exercises a retained local round and public functions with the project .venv only; no provider/network call was made.
No source or test changes were made; this artifact grants no implementation or final acceptance approval.

The live round is one complete round with one successful Web operation, one unavailable OpenAlex operation, one candidate and five gap lens states; pending-plan output projection remains a separate acceptance vector.
Provider capability, real-data, Vault/admin and human scientific gates remain outside this output review.
